# ApkStart v0.4.4

## Changes

- Removed the creator/community popup, social links, QR codes, and promotional material for a cleaner app experience.
- Clarified that first-time Android runtime setup is a large download (often over 1 GB).
- Improved setup progress feedback with transferred/total size, speed, and the file currently being extracted.

## Notes

- The portable package still downloads the Android runtime during first-time setup. The full installer includes the bundled runtime when its Windows build completes.
- Existing Android apps and settings are preserved by this UI cleanup.
